# pool with 10k Workers against epoll-pool with 8 Workers, under backpressure

Date: 2026-11-26. Load: the 10k Phone MIX of `bench/demo/demo.sh`, speed scale 1/10, speed spread 0.35, `--relay backpressure`. Each run is 120 s of `demo.sh act N dry`. The Origin values come from `/proc/<pid>` every 5 s.

- Act 5: Origin `--model pool --workers 10000`.
- Act 4: Origin `--model epoll-pool --workers 8`.

## Result at 120 s

| Value | pool, 10000 Workers | epoll-pool, 8 Workers |
|---|---|---|
| Phones done | 5467 | 4716 |
| Phones receiving | 4533 | 5248 |
| Phones cut | 0 | 36 |
| Origin threads | 10001 | 9 |
| Threads in sleep (S or D) | 10001 | 9 |
| Origin RSS | 308 MiB | 50 MiB |
| Origin virtual memory | 89.1 GiB | 0.1 GiB |
| Context switches since start | 487942 | 74142 |

The two models move the Phones at almost the same speed. The cost is different. In `pool`, a Worker that writes to a full send buffer sleeps in `write()`, and it holds its thread for the whole download.

Open: the 36 cut Phones in Act 4 were 400 kbps Phones that got EOF in the body after about 100 s. The cause is not known.

## Raw samples

Columns: t, threads, run, sleep, rss_mb, vsz_gb, ctxsw, origin_conns, busy, done, receiving, waiting, http_5xx, cut. `pool` writes no `--stats`, so its origin_conns and busy are 0.
